product.title: GK61 61 Keys Gaming Mechanical Keyboard USB Wired RGB Backlit Gamer Mechanical Keyboards For Desktop Tablet Laptop
product.body_html:
Features:

100% brand new and high quality.

61 mechanical keys with poker standard alignment.

Over 100 million times keystroke life, 2 times longer than the

traditional mechanical axis.

ABS bottom shell, double-color ABS/PBT key cap, classic and fashion.

Waterproof / dustproof / anticorrosion.

3-layer programmable download mode (RGB version).

Wonderful shining backlight, 16 million color RGB lighting effects to meet the demands of gamers.

Customize your keyboard's backlighting through the software application.

Ergonomic gaming keyboard design to offer the most comfortable gaming experience.


Drive AP:

1. DIY light effect

2. Powerful game macros

3. There are hundreds of light effects available for download (continuous update)

4. Full-key programmable


Specifications:

Model: GK61

Item Type: USB Wired Mechanical Keyboard

Material: ABS/PBT

Color: Black,White

Axis Body Type: Blue/Red/Black/Brown/Yellow/Silver/Green(Optional)

Axis Body Type: Gateron (Optional) -- ( Gateron is an internationally renowned shaft and feels good touch.)

Backlight Type: RGB Light

Keys: 61 keys

Connection: Wired

Interface: USB 3.1 Type C

USB-C Cable Length (m): 1.5m/4.921ft (Approx.)

Keyboard Lifespan (times): more than 100 million

Bluetooth Version: Support（Bluetooth dual mode version only）

Hot swap : support(Hot Swappable with Optical switches only)

Power Supply: USB Port

Suitable for: PC

Waterproof level: IP68

Quantity: 1 Set (other accessories demo in the picture is not included)


Note:

1.Transition: 1cm=10mm=0.39inch

2.Please allow 0-1cm error due to manual measurement. pls make sure you do not mind before you bid.

3.Due to the difference between different monitors, the picture may not reflect the actual color of the item. Thank you!


Package includes:


1 Set X Wired Mechanical Keyboard
